name: Towarise Corp.
summary: Towarise Corporation engages in the credit business in Japan. The company offers individual and comprehensive credit purchase intermediation, cashing, various consumer loans, and financial institution affiliated loan guarantees. It also sells computers and mobile phones; and rents buildings, as well as offers software development and network consulting services. Further, the company provides transaction services, such as factoring and payroll payment services. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Yonago, Japan.
